interpretation.caveat: These are OUR measurements at the smallest released rung (98,496 parameters), not the paper's headline scaling results. The authors' own numbers for this checkpoint are in the Scaling section.
interpretation.claim: Trained rounds score far below the random-init control, reproducing the paper's central claim on this machine.
interpretation.control: Round 0 is the random initialization and scores ABOVE the uniform-256 baseline of 8.0 bits/byte, which is the expected result for an untrained network and confirms the measurement is sound.

provenance.what: Our own CPU scoring of the authors' released checkpoint on real DCLM text bytes, zero-shot: this model never trained on natural data.
